title: spellbook
summary: MSUI implements Benilla's complete build-5875 spellbook and server cooldown packet family. Initial, learned and superseded spells retain the existing field-exact paths. SMSG_SPELL_COOLDOWN and the four follow-ups now strict-decode, route to the addressed player/pet store, start the fixed 30-second item recovery, park attribute-bit-25 records until SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT, clear one spell plus its category records, and wipe the complete addressed history for SMSG_COOLDOWN_CHEAT. The production build and focused opcode/body/store checks pass; live verification remains.

openItems.text: SMSG_ITEM_COOLDOWN unhandled - the proc-triggered 30 s equipped-item use-cooldown never starts client-side
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: strict raw-u64+u32 parsing resolves the live item instance and starts the use spell's client-hardcoded 30,000 ms recovery in the player/possessed store.

openItems.text: SMSG_COOLDOWN_EVENT unhandled - SPELL_ATTR_COOLDOWN_ON_EVENT abilities never start their parked cooldown timers
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: attribute-bit-25 cooldown records are parked rather than displayed/running, and the addressed event starts every parked node for that spell at packet receive time.

openItems.text: SMSG_CLEAR_COOLDOWN unhandled - a server-cleared cooldown stays running in the UI
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: strict spell-first/raw-guid parsing routes to the player or pet store and removes the spell recovery, every category record owned by that spell, and parked records.

openItems.text: SMSG_COOLDOWN_CHEAT unhandled - the GM .cooldown wipe is ignored
openItems.resolution: 2026-08-22: strict raw-guid parsing routes the GM reset to the addressed player/pet store and clears running plus parked cooldown history.

openItems.text: Golden bodies, strict length rejection, held-event timing, single-spell/category clear, whole-store wipe and production build pass. Needs owner-run live checks for an equipped-item proc cooldown, Stealth/Feign Death event start, one server clear, a pet-addressed follow-up, and a GM .cooldown wipe.
